verdict.rationale: Hatchet is an orchestration platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question. Its official "hatchet-and-mcp" cookbook (titled "Hatchet Agent Tools") shows how to expose Hatchet workflows and standalone tasks as tools that the Claude Agent SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK can invoke. That is a documented integration pattern, not clearly a packaged, first-party MCP server, and the evidence never explicitly calls it an MCP server. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an official MCP server package or hosted endpoint, setup and connection docs for MCP clients, a list of exposed tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
